name: Katoomba
description: A base for visiting Echo Point and the Three Sisters.
history: The town became a municipality in 1889 following growth linked to mining and tourism.
things_to_do: Echo Point viewpoints; Katoomba Falls Night-lit Walk.
food_supplies: Yellow Deli, 214 Katoomba Street, for a cafe stop. Check its current menu and hours. Buy walking supplies before heading to the trail.

name: Blackheath
description: A gateway to Grose Valley lookouts and forest walks.
history: The village was gazetted in 1878 and its first lots were sold in 1879.
things_to_do: Visit Blue Mountains Heritage Centre and Govetts Leap lookout.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Wentworth Falls
description: A starting point for waterfall viewpoints and historic tracks.
history: The settlement took the name Wentworth Falls in 1879.
things_to_do: Visit waterfall viewpoints and the historic Princes Rock track.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Leura
description: A village base for gardens and walks along the Jamison Valley escarpment.
history: Leura railway station opened in 1891 and the Coffee Palace opened in 1892.
things_to_do: Explore Leura village and plan a visit to Everglades House & Gardens.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Lawson
description: A Mid Mountains town with a waterfall circuit close to the village.
history: Previously called Blue Mountain; the town was renamed Lawson in 1879.
things_to_do: Explore the South Lawson waterfall circuit.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Glenbrook
description: A lower-mountain base for the national park entrance and Glenbrook Creek.
history: The nearby Knapsack Viaduct preserves part of the early railway route.
things_to_do: Visit Glenbrook village and plan a walk to Jellybean Pool.
food_supplies: Glenbrook village has cafes, bakeries, grocers and delis for a pre-walk stop; check current hours.

name: Blaxland
description: A lower-mountain starting point for Florabella Pass.
history: Nearby Knapsack Viaduct and Lennox Bridge are regional transport heritage sites.
things_to_do: Explore nearby Knapsack Viaduct and Lennox Bridge; check access.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Warrimoo
description: A residential bushland town at the other end of the Florabella Pass walk.
history: The Florabella Pass route connects the railway towns of Warrimoo and Blaxland.
things_to_do: Plan a Florabella Pass walk towards Blaxland.
food_supplies: For a larger supply stop, plan ahead in nearby Springwood rather than relying on shops at the trailhead.

name: Valley Heights
description: A lower-mountain stop known for its railway museum.
history: The locomotive depot museum occupies the site of a 1914 railway roundhouse.
things_to_do: Visit the Locomotive Depot Heritage Museum on an advertised open day.
food_supplies: For a larger supply stop, plan ahead in nearby Springwood rather than relying on shops at the trailhead.

name: Springwood
description: A lower-mountain service centre with shops and nearby forest gullies.
things_to_do: Explore the town centre and Birdwood Gully.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Faulconbridge
description: A base for art, heritage and the Victory Track.
history: The town takes its name from the maiden name of Sir Henry Parkes' mother.
things_to_do: Visit Norman Lindsay Gallery and gardens; explore Sir Henry Parkes heritage.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Linden
description: A small bushland village with an astronomy heritage site.
history: Telescope maker Ken Beames established the heritage-listed Linden Observatory.
things_to_do: Book an observatory visit or advertised viewing night; no drop-in access.
food_supplies: For a larger supply stop, plan ahead in nearby Springwood rather than relying on shops at the trailhead.

name: Woodford
description: A Mid Mountains village with heritage buildings and waterfall walks.
history: Woodford Academy began as an inn in the 1830s and later became a boarding school.
things_to_do: Plan a visit to Woodford Academy on an advertised open day.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.

name: Hazelbrook
description: A Mid Mountains base for local waterfall walks.
history: The village was named after Hazelbrook House, built in the 1870s.
things_to_do: Explore Horseshoe Falls; check the map before extending to other waterfalls.
food_supplies: Plan food and grocery stops before your walk; check local shops and opening hours separately.
